title: atip/1 envelope
description: The one JSON document a command prints on stdout with --json (spec section 6). `ok` is true exactly when the exit code is 0. Closed for tools of the current minor; callers read it open (spec 15.8). Members added after 1.0 carry `x-atip-since`.

data.description: The output. Its JSON Schema is the schemaRef of the output meta.output names (or of the command's only output).
The partial output of a command that ran (exit 1): a failed check's findings, a stopped batch's report. Never on a refusal (exit 2).

command.description: The command id (path words joined by one space) resolved so far. Omitted when not even the first word resolved.

contractVersion.description: The contract version the tool implements, <major>.<minor>; absent means 1.0 (spec 15.7). Set with `contract` by every tool that implements 1.1 or later.

output.description: The name, in the command's `schemas`, of the output schema `data` follows (spec 6.6).

context.description: Keys: camelCase names of the options that select context; values: the values the command used; paths relative to the working directory (spec 6.7).

coverage.description: What a check or listing examined (spec 8.5).

fields.description: The field paths `data` was projected to with --fields, the always-kept ones included (spec 6.10).

fieldPath.description: A path into a record (spec 6.10). The first branch is the 1.0 grammar, unchanged: `name`, `.name` and `[]` after a name. The second, since 1.1, also admits a bracketed key `["…"]` for a member whose name is not an identifier, the empty name included and U+0000 excluded, since argv cannot carry it (spec 6.10); inside the quotes only `\"` and `\\` are escapes. Brackets are valid only for such names (spec 10.13 rule 15) and only in documents that declare 1.1 (rule 16).

command.description: The whole invocation as one display string, starting with the tool name.

argv.description: The same invocation as argument words, without the executable. Every word is literal.

page.description: Paging (spec 6.9). nextCursor is present exactly when more items follow.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into `data` of the list or value cut.
